title: Inspector
readOnly: Read-only: Paperless has not confirmed permission to change this document.
risk: Other applications can change this document while you save. A custom-field save replaces the complete collection and can overwrite their changes. Pause other writers before saving.
acknowledge: I understand that concurrent external edits can be lost.
noRollback: Edits are immediate. There is no durable edit history or rollback yet.
conflict: The document or its field definitions changed. Your draft is kept. Reload and review before editing again.
forbidden: Paperless does not permit this action (403).
notFound: Document missing or no longer visible to this credential (404).
uncertain: The save could not be confirmed. It may have reached Paperless. Reload and inspect the stored value before another edit.
monetary: Use a currency code and an exact amount, for example EUR1234.56. No comma decimals.
